name: Dagens brev til Tone
_purpose: A short daily letter to Tone Lein, the editor this desk serves. Correspondence, not a product: the briefs carry the news, the letter carries what a brief has no room for -- what the desk noticed and could not use, and where the machine is probably wrong.
_schedule_note: An hour after the morning brief, so the letter can refer to it.
_provider_note: GPT-5, not Gemini. Gemini's prepaid credits run dry most days and take drafting down with them; a letter that silently stops arriving is worse than one written by a second model. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty on this machine, so Claude was not an option (2026-09-30).
_deliverers_note: Addressed to the account owner, NOT to Tone. Her address is not recorded anywhere in this repo and was not invented -- add it here when you have it, and the letter goes straight to her.
_max_items_note: Raised from 25 on 2026-10-10. The letter is asked to span Norway, Europe and the US, and the top 25 by score can be -- and on 10 October was -- entirely one beat. A wider window is what makes the spread possible rather than aspirational.
